name: ClawSight
description: Engine-agnostic Docker plugin that exposes wsinsight / sptxinsight / hplot / kurtorank / wsitrain as 5 MCP tools each (start / stop / status / list_tools / call). Per-engine defaults can be overridden via CLAWSIGHT_<ENGINE>_IMAGE / _PORT / _CONTAINER / _MCP_URL / _TIMEOUT_MS environment variables.

configSchema.description: ClawSight reads per-engine defaults from process.env (see description). Plugin config is reserved for future host-level overrides; no fields are required.
